summary: Tested the branch copy v2 changes: Rupiah/Persen mode, Salin harga and Salin stok switches, protection of prices set by the branch admin, overwrite option, big_rise warning, and apply. Backend: tests/test_branch_copy_pct.py has 16 tests, run with -n0 and BC_ALLOW_APPLY=1. 14 pass and 2 fail, both on a real float rounding bug in percent mode. Validation (422), pct preview values, copy_stock=false (stock_changed 0) and copy_price=false (price_changed 0) all pass. big_rise also passes (pct 60 gives 6618 = price_changed). Protection passes: a PUT by jombang@pgs.id sets manual_price_at, and preview then reports protected=1 with branch_price and would_be. With overwrite_manual it reports protected_overwritten=1. Apply in pct mode keeps the protected price and manual_price_at. Other products get the exact pct price, original_price and every tier price, and their stock is not touched. price_history rows contain only price fields. A second apply returns 400. Apply with copy_stock=true still copies stock onto the protected row, and its history row is stock only. Apply with overwrite sets the price to the rule value, clears manual_price_at, and writes no stock change. Frontend at 390px: all testIDs are present and work. Defaults are correct (copy_stock OFF, rp 2000/1000, sub 3/5). Switching chips works, and comma decimals work ('2,5' becomes 2.5). With both switches off, the 'Centang ...' error shows. bc-sum, bc-big, bc-protected with its sample and overwrite switch, and bc-sample all render. Recalculating flips the message to 'AKAN ditimpa'. The confirm dialog summary is correct, Cancel works, and a zero-change apply shows bc-msg-ok. DATA: all 13236 store_stock docs for jombang and jember were backed up and restored exactly (0 mismatches, 0 manual_price_at left). price_history (13236), product_events (0) and notifications (1043) are back to the backup counts. Test previews and TEST_ guest carts were deleted.

critical.issue: Percent rounding uses floats in branch_copy.py:37 (math.ceil(v*(1+pct/100)/100)*100). Prices that should land exactly on Rp100 get bumped up by Rp100. pct=10: 3000->3400 (expected 3300), 6000->6700, 11000->12200. pct=7: 30000->32200 (expected 32100), 60000->64300. Measured over the real catalog's distinct prices (6458), including tier prices: 495 wrong at 10% and 18 at 7%. 1, 2, 2.5, 3, 5, 15, 20 and -10 were correct.

minor.issue: Stale test, not an app bug. The branches are already copied, so the rp preview has an empty sample and b['sample'][0] raises IndexError. Also, with BC_ALLOW_APPLY=1 its TestApply applies to both branches with stock (restored).

ui_bugs.issue: The hint uses the same float formula (branch-copy.tsx:66). At 10% it shows 'Rp200.000 → Rp220.100' instead of Rp220.000.

Typing 150 still shows '150' in the field, but price_pct is silently clamped to 100 (the hint shows 100%). The displayed value and the sent value differ. Negative percent (allowed by the backend down to -50) and negative Rp cannot be typed.

issues: Protected sample lines use numberOfLines=1, so at 390px the rule price '(aturan: Rp218.400)' is cut off ('(atu...')
When overwrite_manual is on, the protected box lists no product names (protected_sample is empty); only the count shows
Toggling the overwrite switch clears the whole preview, so the switch itself disappears until the user recalculates (a message explains this)
Switch hit area is 40x20 on web; only the Switch is tappable, not the whole ToggleRow

action_items: HIGH: Do the percent rounding in integers or Decimal in branch_copy.price_fn, e.g. math.ceil(round(v*(100+pct)*100) / 10000 / 100)*100, or use Decimal. Pick an approach that is exact for 1-decimal pct, e.g. compute v*(1000+pct*10) as an int, then divide by 1000 and ceil to 100. Mirror the same math in the branch-copy.tsx hint.
LOW: Clamp the shown percent text to 100 (or show an error). Consider allowing negative percent to match the backend's -50.
LOW: Show the full rule price in the protected sample (2 lines). Optionally keep the overwrite switch visible after toggling.
Update or delete the stale test_branch_copy.py::test_preview_counts sample assertion.
critical_code_review_comments: branch_copy.py:37 float arithmetic in money rounding (see critical issue).
The protection logic is correct. Protected rows never get 'price' in set, so manual_price_at is kept. Overwritten rows get $unset manual_price_at. Stock is still copied for protected rows.
Rules for a branch with both copy flags off are still sent, and the success message lists them as '0 produk'. Harmless.

success_rate.backend: 87.5% (14/16; the 2 failures are the float rounding bug)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work; the hint shows the float rounding bug)

seed_data_creation: None kept. Temporary changes were a manual price on pgs-9955 (Jombang) and full pct/rp applies to Jombang. All were restored from the backup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: python tests/backup/bc_pct_backup.py, then cd backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<frontend/.env> BC_ALLOW_APPLY=1 pytest tests/test_branch_copy_pct.py -n0, then python tests/backup/bc_pct_restore.py. The restore replaces jombang/jember store_stock from the pickle and removes branch_copy/branch_price history at or after t0, plus tracked previews. Do NOT run tests/test_branch_copy.py with BC_ALLOW_APPLY=1 unless you back up first. Login: email-input, password-input, login-submit. Confirm dialog: confirm-dialog, confirm-ok, confirm-cancel.
rca_of_issue: 1+pct/100 is not exactly representable as a float (1.1 = 1.100000000000000088...). v*1.1 gives e.g. 3300.0000000000005, and ceil(33.000000000000005) = 34, so the price goes up an extra Rp100. Reproduce: python tests/backup/bc_pct_float.py. Fix with integer or Decimal math.
